example_prompts: We just raised a $2M seed for our B2B SaaS and have six people: two founders, three engineers and a designer. Who should we hire next, and what will it do to our runway? We have about 15 months now.
We're two technical founders at pre-seed. What should our first five hires be, in what order, and roughly what should we pay each of them?
Build a 12-month hiring plan and budget for a 10-person seed-stage SaaS startup in London that wants to reach 18 people.
What equity should we offer our first five employees, and how big should our option pool be at seed? We have two founders and 4-year vesting.
